mutant.description: No change was made, so no defect was planted. The discriminating arm is the census itself: a reader that reads the secret and then fails elsewhere is separated from a reader that never reaches the read, by reading each run's output for the fetch line and for AccessDenied.
mutant.expected: If Failed status meant 'no secret read', the four runs would show no fetch line; if the grant were already ineffective they would show AccessDenied.
mutant.observed: All 4 latest runs show 'Fetching credentials from Secrets Manager...', no AccessDenied, then 'Phase 1: Login' and a TimeoutError: the read succeeds daily.
